thesis: Alphabet (GOOGL) exhibits robust growth and strong fundamentals, highlighting significant revenue and margin improvements alongside a promising outlook in cloud services and AI technology.

arguments.point: 2025 revenue reached 402.8B, up 15% YoY, with a net income of 132.2B and a solid net margin of 32.8%.
Strong backlog in Google Cloud, with backlog anticipated to grow from 242.8B in 2025 to 567.7B by 9/30/2026, indicating substantial future revenue opportunities.
Google's cloud revenue reportedly doubled in the past year, showing strong growth in their cloud division amid competition.
Launch of two new AI chip systems targeting specialized computing workloads signifies a strategic move to enhance Google's AI capabilities and competitive position.

weaknesses_acknowledged: Net income in 9M 2026 includes large, non-operating gains from equity securities, which may distort earnings visibility.
Ongoing regulatory and legal risks, including antitrust matters, could affect future performance and cash flows.
The technical analysis indicates a current downtrend in stock price and underperformance relative to the market.
